takes.situation: She mistakes him for a Bureau man until he says he paid; she questions him.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: They send a man now? The clockwork collector was bad enough.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not the Bureau, no. I've paid them part of your loan.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Not so loud, the terrace hears. Why pay a stranger's loan?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We look after people. One day we'd ask you a small favour.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: What favour? Who's been asking about me?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: The books get read. Let's keep to the loan, shall we?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I won't send it back, I can't. But don't ask me yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Then I won't, not today. I'll be back with the rest.

learned: Inez took it. Not ready yet.

takes.situation: She says yes far too fast, and he won't take a yes that hollow.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I've paid part of your Bureau loan, Miss Nikolaou. Just now.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Did anyone see you? Whatever it is, I'll do it.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: You don't know me. You don't even know what I'd ask.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Will a stamped card come here, with my name on it?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: It stays at the Bureau. And your yes wouldn't last the shift.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: No. I'll keep what you paid, but I can't do anything yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We'd want one word to someone. I'll be back with the rest.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Then come quietly. And please, don't say my name out here.

learned: Inez took it. Not ready yet.

takes.situation: She calls it a mistake and tries to undo it; he shows it can't be undone.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Part of my Bureau loan? Mister, you've got the wrong girl.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Inez Nikolaou, behind with the Bureau. I paid part of it.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who told you that? Have it sent back, before someone sees.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: It went down their tube and got stamped. It doesn't come back.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I don't know you, and I've tables. What's it going to cost?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nothing today. Later, one small thing that hurts nobody.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'll keep it, then. I can't do a thing for it yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not yet, no. I'll come back with the rest, and we'll talk.

learned: Inez took it. Not ready yet.
